findings.claim: A failed runtime pin toggle is not rolled back, so the command reports failure after already changing the daemon's live isolation mode.
findings.evidence: actions.rs sets state.pin_tab and calls BrowserManager::set_pin_tab before loading/saving the binding. With a live pinned session and a non-writable binding directory, `--no-pin-tab get url --json` returned a persistence error; the following unflagged command succeeded with a persistence warning that omitted the pin-isolation warning, confirming the daemon remained unpinned. The symmetric failed enable remained enabled in memory.
findings.layer: foreground CLI through daemon state and filesystem persistence
findings.path: CLI pinTab envelope -> execute_command state mutation -> tab_binding::save failure -> next command observes mutated state

findings.claim: Added lines violate the repository rule that forbids em dashes in code, output, and documentation.
findings.evidence: gate.sh style reported eight added lines containing an em dash: four user-facing error strings, three comments/doc comments, and one skill-data prose line.

findings.claim: The new regression tests have not been proven to fail when their guarded implementation is reverted.
findings.evidence: The force-red gate requires reverting implementation code while retaining tests; the review hard constraint prohibits any source modification, so this empirical layer was unavailable.
